head: codex/5821-v092-distributed-guardian-gate
title: [v0.92][WP-04] Freeze the distributed Guardian architecture and security gate
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5821

## Summary
- freeze the OpenRaft majority-authority, joint-membership, lease, fencing, and recovery contract
- pin the reviewed quinn, rustls, prost, and openraft dependency set under WP-04.03's sole Cargo manifest ownership
- define the canonical AuthorityCertificateV1 possession and mutation-sink verification boundary
- align the exact sixteen-child WP-04 execution wave with exclusive ownership, proof, and rollback contracts
- retain independent exact-head architecture and lifecycle reviews with no actionable findings

## Validation
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5821/validate-architecture-security-review.rb`
- `ruby .csdlc/prepared/issues/5821/validate-child-wave.rb`
- typed C-SDLC v2 doctor for #5821 plus focused child doctors: pass
- `git diff --check`

This PR is the architecture/security gate only. Distributed product implementation and deployment proof remain owned by WP-04.01 through WP-04.16.
